title: NarraFork remote access
unsupported: This feature is not supported over remote access yet.
attachmentTooLarge: Remote messages and attachments must total no more than 7 MiB.
adminOnly: Sign in as an administrator. Password and TOTP or backup codes are supported; registration, SSO and passkeys are not available here.
sessionEnded: The remote session has ended. Reconnect to sign in again. If your pairing is still valid, no new invitation is needed.
failed: Remote connection failed. Reconnect using your invitation.
loginFailed: Sign-in failed. Check your credentials and connection.
unsupportedMfa: This account requires a sign-in method that is unavailable here. Use TOTP or a backup code on the ordinary NarraFork site.
